steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, the stealth team has failed. Four members have been injured and require emergency Mania treatment...
The mission operatives report to you. Meanwhile, the Executive Committee representative who's just arrived keeps grumbling.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Ridiculous. What kind of world do we live in? Where do all these Mania Crystals and Mania weapons come from?! Something on this scale was rare even before BR-004...

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: We'll launch an attack. I don't want to waste any more time on these scums!
It's too risky.
The Homeless are still in there. An attack will mean instant death for them.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: What does that matter to us? Just a bunch of little *****. Are they worth more than Syndicate's safety?
You look at Crache on the side. She shows no reaction to the Executive Committee representative's words and seems surprisingly calm.
No, I'm against that.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Then what's your plan? Your stealth team is useless now. What else can you do?
You turn to face Crache.
I can trust you, right?
If you can't do it, no one else can.
Still, Crache says nothing. A silent, raging shadow wraps around her body as she walks straight ahead to the building in front of her.
This is her answer.
Once Crache vanishes from your sight, you hear the Executive Committee representative's irritating voice again.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: She's alone. Are you sure you're not sending your Sinner to die?
She'll make it...
The Homeless have always trusted her, and she's never let them down.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: ****, that ******* Bureau just won't let us loose.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: Good thing we warded them off. We lost nine brothers though...

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: Don't get carried away. That was only a few of them. The real attack is coming soon.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: **** it, let's use all the Mania Crystals we have left!
The woman in charge knocks on the table to silence the clamoring crowd.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: Silence.
The High Priest in a black cloak stands up silently and slowly makes her way to the children who are trembling in the corner.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: But we do have some available sacrifices here, don't we?
Recognizing their boss's meaning instantly, the Thou Voodoos members walk toward the kids of the Homeless with menacing smiles.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: You've stolen our Mania Crystals. Now it's time to pay your interest.
Puff!
A sharp shadow appears out of nowhere and gently penetrates the cloaked woman's chest.
The woman who's survived the most ruthless gang fights is unable to resist and flops down noiselessly.
The Thou Voodoos' guys are responsive and show no hesitation after the collapse of their boss. Their blind faith and the Mania Crystals' influence have long destroyed their sanity.
All that's left in their brains is madness. If anything, their boss's death has shattered their last strand of sanity.

steps.speaker: Thou Voodoos Member
steps.content: Mon... Monster!!!
They're perhaps right. Monster. The figure wrapped in a wriggling shadow is just like a monster descending from darkness.
All attacks prove futile. Even Mania-loaded bullets and blades are like sunken stones in a lake, devoured by that vast darkness.
In return, the darkness extends her furious tentacles, mysterious thick spikes bursting out of the ground.
Pierced, torn, devoured... These so-called monsters who've consumed Mania Crystals have now become the prey of another monster pathetically.
It's a chaos made of interwoven malice, rage, and pain.
When you barge in with the team, it's already over.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Confirm safety of hostages.

The mission operative shines his flashlight toward the corner of the walls. Having been deprived of sunlight in the dark room for several days, the children seem sensitive to light and cover their faces tremulously.
Their expressions are confused and agonized. It's hard to imagine what they've been through in the past few days.
On the other side, Crache stands in the center of the room, the furious darkness fully retracted back into her body. Right now, she looks just like an ordinary child.
Well done... Crache.
Crache doesn't respond.
The darkness has engulfed everything that's occurred here, as well as Crache's small face.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, the battle has damaged the building's structure. This place is very dangerous now... Please retreat asap!
Soon after all of you have retreated from the apartment, the old building can no longer support its own weight and collapses into a massive pile of rubble.
The operation has gone on for two hours. This is a residential area, and some of the residents have been gathering around.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: My home... My home is gone! What on earth just happened...

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: It's all because of those little ***** from the Homeless. They've drawn Thou Voodoos and the police here.
A woman is yelling at you at the top of her lungs. She picks up a piece of rubble and throws it in your way.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: It's all your fault!
The early spring air is still cool, and many of the rescued children are only wearing tattered thin clothes.
Standing in the ruin, they shiver under the chilly wind and curses. You see the boy who once led the way for you and Crache cringe like a scared rabbit, too scared to make a sound.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Hey you cops, keep these little ***** locked up in the prison. Never let them back out again!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: In the prison? What good does that do?!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: You owe me my home!

steps.speaker: The Homeless
steps.content: Wahhhhh...
Surrounded by these adults, the youngest child finally breaks down and cries out loudly.
Infected by the mood, the other kids start tearing up too.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Oh, now you're crying? You little bastards liked to play gangsters in the past.
You can't bear watching this and ask the mission operatives to disperse the crowd. Meanwhile, the Executive Committee representative comes next to you.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Oh? You've really caught them all. Good job, Chief of the MBCC. Your Sinner is indeed very useful.
I'm only doing my best to get my job done.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Hmm, it's great to have a reliable partner like you as our support.
What do you plan to do with these kids?
Syndicate is now under the Executive Committee's administration. Officially, only they have the right to decide the next step. But out of concern, you can't help asking.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: These little punks? Don't mind them. Just release them later.
Release them?!

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: What? They're alive and Mania-free. They're not your responsibility.
But they're clearly traumatized... Thou Voodoos may still be lurking around too. What if they retaliate?
The Executive Committee representative looks you up and down in an amused fashion.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: I've always heard the Chief of the MBCC has a kind heart. So the rumors are true.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Go easy on yourself, Chief. Things like this happen everywhere in Syndicate. You can't help everyone.
But they desperately need help.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Then help them yourself. The Executive Committee is not a charity.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Besides, if we let these little punks survive this, they'll grow up to be the new Thou Voodoos or some new gang in a few years. That's why they say Syndicate doesn't have a future.
You notice something wrong with Crache behind you and want to stop the Executive Committee representative from talking. But blunt as he is, he keeps jabbering on.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Anyway, it doesn't matter. In a few years, when they're of age, they'll fall into our hands. By that time, the Ethics Committee can't bother us anymore...
He seems to suddenly think of something and says.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: That being said, we still need to close this case. I recall the instigator of this incident is a pink-haired kid, right?
He looks toward the group from the Bureau and spots Sandy in the crowd.
Sandy is presently in a similar mental state as the kidnapped members of the Homeless. The series of happenings these few days has resulted in a mental breakdown in her.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: How very considerate of you. You've even brought the culprit to us.
The Executive Committee representative walks toward your team and grabs Sandy by her hair.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: We can't let little punks like you go easily, or else Syndicate's safety will be in a shambles...
Screaming, Sandy falls down and gets dragged on the ground by her hair.

steps.speaker: Sandy
steps.content: Crache! Help me...
You rush over to stop the Executive Committee representative's cruel act, but you're too late.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Ah!!
A painful cry interrupts your conversation. You notice that the shadow has already swum by you and penetrated his foot forcefully.
Crache has acted.
You turn around instantly and call out to Crache.
Crache, calm down!
Crache glances at you placidly, then turns her gaze back to the man from the Executive Committee.
They're entangled in countless shadows. You dash toward Crache and grab her hand.
Don't let your anger control you! What they say doesn't matter. What matters is you, and the Homeless... You still have a future...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Back off!!!
Crache struggles free from your hand. An immense power throws you to the side, and you fall onto the ground.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: The Homeless needs no future from you!
Crache roars, and an enormous shadow shrouds the ground and the sky.
You can't just stand back and watch Crache make a huge mistake. That leaves you with the only choice.

At last, the Homeless were taken by the Executive Committee, but were released two days later. They have completely vanished in the next two months.
As the culprit, Sandy's been detained by the Executive Committee.
Crache refuses to talk to anyone.
The silence in the confinement cell is almost creepy.
Three months have passed since the Mania Crystal incident. In these three months, you haven't had even one normal conversation with Crache.
She's attempted several escapes but was stopped by you each time.
You've been wanting to talk to her, but you're not sure where to start.
This time though, to your surprise, Crache speaks first.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: How's Sandy?
Her real age is older than sixteen...
The Executive Officer insists that she's the chief instigator of the Mania Crystal incident. In a month, she'll be trialed at the West District Provisional Court.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha... They've caught the perfect scapegoat... Must be good for their performance review...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Mania Crystals have plagued the city for years. Have those scumbags ever done anything about the gangs? Now that the gangs are gone, they've decided to make an example of an innocent kid?!
I'll fight for her.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Fight for what? For them to release her? Then what? The Homeless, there are still so many of them in that hellhole Syndicate. They can't survive on their own. They'll keep stealing, keep robbing, keep getting arrested.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You're gonna fight for each one of them?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I appreciate your perseverance, Chief.
Syndicate... is indeed not the best environment for them. I plan to find a suitable organization to adopt them.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: See, you don't even believe in it yourself.
It's perhaps not possible... in the Syndicate today.
But I and many other people are still working hard to reestablish order and build trust among the citizens...
One day...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's too late!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I know, I know... Even if you release her, Sandy won't change. She's used to that way of life. She even lied to me. She'll never come around.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: But who can steer clear of the filth when you live in that damn gutter Syndicate? Can those adults even do that?!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's not like that? Chief, you have a good heart, you really do. You want to give everyone a hand.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: But so many of them need a hand. Can you save them all?

options: Even if I can't, I must try...

choices.text: Even if I can't, I must try...

steps.content: Crache, you face a burden too heavy for a child. You're still too young. Let adults handle it. We have the power and responsibility to protect children. We will protect you.
You want to grab her hand.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Don't touch me!
She slaps off your hand almost reflexively.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Adults... Haha... Adults who protect children... Haha... I'm afraid you're the only one...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: If they have the power, shouldn't they save it for themselves? This is Syndicate. Weak kids like us should be at their mercy. Why do we deserve protection?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Save your talks of justice and ethics. The powerless kids of the Homeless are at the bottom of the food chain. There's only one way to survive.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Do whatever you must to get stronger, grow up, become an adult, become the next generation of scumbags, and create the next generation of the Homeless.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Don't you understand? Born in Syndicate, we're all the same! Do you still think you can save any of us?!
Her eyes are red from dryness, but there's a deep sadness in her cracked voice that tightly grips your heart.
For so long, you were the only one to protect the children, with your power as a child. Even in a place like Syndicate, you have always steered clear of the filth.
But you're only a child, that duty shouldn't fall on your shoulders. I'll help you. We'll create a future you want to see.
You grab her hand again. She tries hard to struggle free, but you hold it tightly.
Finally, she's tired of struggling and gives up.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Haha... What am I doing... Throwing a tantrum at you...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Chief... No... ${PlayerName}... Sorry... You're a good person... A really good person...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Don't feel sorry for me... And don't... pity me...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm lucky enough to be detained here...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Too lucky... I became a Sinner... and met you...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: But ${PlayerName}... The world... is so big... The night... is so long...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Not everyone is as lucky...
She turns her gaze away from you. Her body begins slipping down the wall slowly.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Most kids from the Homeless won't turn into Sinners... They'll either become degenerates themselves or die together...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Most Sinners won't meet you... They'll be ripped apart and tortured until they become total monsters, only then will they find relief...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You and I being here today... is a miracle that should have been impossible...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Most other kids like Crache are not as lucky... They won't even get a chance to throw a tantrum at you...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: They're the majority... ${PlayerName}, that's the reality... In a world like this... there's no future I desire...
You open your mouth, but no words come out. You can only grip her hand tightly, even though that scrawny hand has given up struggling.

options: At least I've grabbed your hand, here, now.

choices.text: At least I've grabbed your hand, here, now.

steps.content: Have faith in yourself, Crache... You said you're lucky enough to have met me. I'm sure... you'll be lucky enough to find a way to change the future...
I can't promise you anything... except that... I won't let go of your hand, and I won't let you face anything on your own again...
In the shadow, tears glide down Crache's face noiselessly. After a long moment, she answers.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Yeah? Then I'm really...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Too lucky...
She doesn't meet your gaze again.
